blurb: Guests take guided fishing trips on the Twentymile River for salmon and trout, with options for half-day or full-day private or group tours. Trips include scenic jet boat rides with wildlife viewing opportunities and customizable experiences such as riverside campfires and smoked salmon sampling. Transportation from Anchorage or Girdwood is available for an additional fee.
